items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: When I joined Cab Calloway's band, Milt Hinton and I stayed together.

ctx.x: S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
When I joined Cab Calloway's band, Milt Hinton and I stayed together. We had a big dressing room like this -- just the two of us in there.

And Milt Hinton had these great big [hands display] sets like (inaudible) road with us, and we'd play classic records and we'd just close the doors. We wouldn't let nobody play all the classic records.
